notes: The arXiv API was unreachable (HTTP 429, then two timeouts), so Phase 1.5 literature check could not run in strict mode; all recommended references are knowledge-based and marked [verify], and no similarity/novelty/scout/coverage output exists. SKILL.md says the literature check follows the reviewer drafts, but the fingerprint and searches were attempted before the reports were written out (reviewers did not use any results; none were obtained). The skill's rule that Overall 4 needs pool position >=65 while the script's pool band for 55-69 is 55-61 is a small mismatch; R3/R4 were set at 65/66 and the script showed bands 55-61 for them without warnings. Figures were unavailable; judged from captions and appendix tables. Running five reviewers sequentially in one context cannot give true independence; I wrote each from the paper and paper memory only. The EIC 'weights start at 1.0' rule and the ban on penalizing role sit slightly in tension with using DA/R3 weights; I moved weights only for verified points. The compound-shell restriction in this environment forced separate script calls.
